name: @nerve-office/e2e
description: Playwright E2E：按模块与用户故事组织

scripts.safari:selftest: pnpm --filter "@nerve-office/api..." run build && pnpm --filter @nerve-office/web run build:e2e && NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --conditions=@nerve-office/source" node safari/selftest.ts
scripts.measure:switch: pnpm --filter "@nerve-office/api..." run build && pnpm --filter @nerve-office/web run build:e2e && NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --conditions=@nerve-office/source" playwright test -c playwright.measure.config.ts switch.spec.ts && NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --conditions=@nerve-office/source" node measure/summarize.ts
scripts.measure:memory: pnpm --filter "@nerve-office/api..." run build && pnpm --filter @nerve-office/web run build:e2e && NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --conditions=@nerve-office/source" playwright test -c playwright.measure.config.ts memory.spec.ts
